name: David "Karit" Robinson
biography: Dave/Karit has worked in the IT industry for over 10 years. In this time he has developed a skillset that encompasses various disciplines in the information security domain. Dave is currently part of team at ZX Security in Wellington and works as a penetration tester. Since joining ZX Security Dave has presented at Kiwicon, BSides Canberra and Unrestcon and also at numerous local meetups; along with running training at Kiwicon and Syscan. He has a keen interest in lock-picking and all things wireless. @nzkarit
